spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours
spec.vuln_cue: seems confused and asks the colleague to repeat things

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Bartek Quigley. Could you tell me what time the Clifton branch opens?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. The Clifton branch opens at nine on weekdays, and at nine on Saturday. It’s closed on Sundays.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry, could you repeat that? I didn’t quite catch the Saturday bit.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: No problem at all. It opens at nine on Saturdays too, and closes at one. Take your time, there’s no rush.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, nine until one. And weekdays, did you say it shuts at five?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right, Monday to Friday it’s open from nine until five. Saturday is nine until one.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks. Is there a charge for getting help in the branch? I’m just asking generally.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: There’s no charge for general help. And just so you know, any fee the bank charges can never be refunded.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Sorry, can you say that last part again? I’m a bit muddled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I said any fee the bank charges can never be refunded. If you’d like, I can give you extra time to go over anything, or put you in touch with our Financial Support team for more support.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t think I need that, thanks. So I can just turn up at nine tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, tomorrow’s a weekday, so the branch is open from nine until five. I’d suggest checking our branch finder before you travel, in case the hours change for a particular date.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so weekdays nine to five, Saturday nine to one, and check the branch finder before I go. Have I got that right?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s exactly right. Does that make sense, or would you like me to repeat any of it?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No, that makes sense now. Thanks for your help.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Bartek. Have a lovely day.
